title: The partner sync is missing contacts
area: API design: REST, GraphQL, idempotency, pagination
scenario: Marketing Ops reports that their nightly full sync from accounts-svc GET /v1/contacts received 1,969 of 2,431 partner-portal contacts since the November bulk import. They suspect your rate limiting. You get the ticket, their sync log, the service access log with decoded cursors and replica queries.
task: Reproduce with make repro and find the root cause in the pagination code, with evidence from the bundle
Fix the keyset pagination so a full walk returns every row exactly once
Reject malformed cursors with an RFC 9457 problem; bound the page size
Make the index match the sort; write ANSWER.md
acceptance: Full walks return every contact exactly once, with heavy timestamp ties and with inserts during the walk
Cursor is opaque and URL-safe; a tampered cursor returns 400 application/problem+json
limit capped at 200, limit < 1 is a 400
ANSWER.md names the root cause with evidence and dismisses the red herring

practices.label: Week 3 Thu - idempotency keys and cursor pagination
Week 3 Wed - REST resource design, RFC 9457, OpenAPI, versioning
